stage_order: x1 is dated before q1, which it names
x1 is dated before c1, which it names
authorisation_recheck: x1: the recheck comes after the attempt
x1: attempted after a recheck that found unavailable

id_cited.what: the DPS attempt cites the receipt by id (urn:aer1:receipt:<id>)
id_cited.binding: DPS side under the issuer's seal; the id is in the receipt's metadata block (metadata_hash)

output_hash_named.what: the DPS result names the receipt's output_hash
output_hash_named.binding: DPS side under the issuer's seal; output_hash commits to the canonical bytes

executor_names_caller.what: the DPS attempt's executor_ref names the caller committed in the receipt
executor_names_caller.binding: the caller is in the canonical bytes; here an anonymous caller (basis ip_ua_30d, rotates 2026-12-03T00:00:00.000Z): pseudonymous, not an identity

request_id_committed.what: the receipt records the DPS request_id among its inputs (idempotency key)
request_id_committed.binding: the canonical bytes record no input at all; nothing in the receipt names the request

input_is_approved.what: the receipt's recorded input is the approved parameters
input_is_approved.binding: only through input_hash, which is outside metadata_hash and outside the canonical bytes (Section 3.3): sha256 of the approved parameters under the layout as its name reads; not confirmed by the verifier, and anyone holding the receipt can change it

pointer_to_record.what: the receipt's execution_context names the decision record
pointer_to_record.binding: execution_context names environment, quota_identity, source; no decision record

attempt_before_receipt.what: the DPS attempt (2026-11-10T10:51:44.650Z) is dated no later than the receipt's created_at (2026-11-10T10:51:44.721Z)
attempt_before_receipt.binding: issuer's clock against the receipt store's clock; created_at is in metadata_hash

result_after_receipt.what: the DPS result naming output_hash (2026-11-10T10:57:15Z) is dated no earlier than created_at
result_after_receipt.binding: a stage cannot name an output_hash before the receipt holding it was created

review_after_receipt.what: the review (2026-11-10T10:59:00Z) was shown a view naming the receipt, so it is dated no earlier than created_at
review_after_receipt.binding: the view's digest is in the person's signed bytes; the receipt's id and created_at are in metadata_hash

order.time_basis: the issuer's stage times and the receipt store's created_at; no independent timestamp over either, so an approval dated before the effect is the issuer's statement, never verified

id.rule: Section 3: lowercase UUID, not nil; strict tier: version 4 with RFC 4122 variant bits

created_at.rule: Section 3, Section 6 step 4: RFC 3339, a real calendar date, no leap second
created_at.detail: form and calendar validity only, not that the time is true (Section 13)

tool.rule: Table 1: an object with name, version and scope

provenance_class.rule: Section 5: one of the three classes

output_hash.rule: Section 4, Section 6 step 3: sha256 of the decoded canonical bytes equals output_hash

canonical_byte_length.rule: profile member, not in the draft: the decoded length

metadata_hash.rule: Section 3.1, Section 6 step 4: the metadata block recomputed from the stored members (id, created_at, tool, provenance_class, schema version, output_hash)

committed_version_and_class.rule: kit rule 11 (read with the draft): the version and provenance class inside the canonical bytes equal the outer members

outer_copies_of_committed_members.rule: profile: the outer caller, side_effects and tool equal the committed ones

verification_status.rule: Table 1: "verified" when the stored record passes Section 6

input_hash.rule: Section 3.3: the recorded input, in the canonical bytes, under the published layout

anchor_report.rule: Section 6 per-anchor report: present / evaluated / outcome

issuer.rule: draft -26 core: no signature member; the receipt's own checks say so

independent_verifier_probe.note: a probe on a copy, not the receipt: what the rest of the procedure says

id_verdict.source: the author's mail of 10 November 2026 (the issuer's own channel: it binds the record to the issuer's assertion and no further, Section 6)

times_stated.reading: the upstream price was fetched 2.4 s before the step started; the committed output text says 'cache age 2s'. Only created_at is bound (metadata_hash); none is independently timed here
